title: Accountant
description: Accountant Location: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia Company: VAS Global Services Employment Type: Full-Time About the Role VAS Global Services is looking for an experienced Accountant – Operations to manage the financial activities of our Visa Application Centre in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia . The role will be responsible for branch accounting, cash and revenue reconciliation, financial reporting, payroll support, refunds, audit preparation, and compliance, while working closely with the central Finance team and operational departments. Key Responsibilities Manage daily financial transactions and maintain accurate accounting records. Handle cash collections, visa fees, VAS revenue, POS settlements, and bank deposits. Manage billing, fee collection, service charges, and revenue postings. Process and monitor refunds, waivers, and revenue adjustments. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly financial and revenue reports. Perform cash, bank, POS, and revenue reconciliations. Support payroll processing, including attendance, overtime, allowances, deductions, and incentives. Monitor revenue, transaction volumes, payroll costs, and operational expenses. Support budgeting, cost control, vendor payments, and expense management. Investigate financial discrepancies and ensure timely corrective action. Maintain accurate and audit-ready financial records. Support internal, statutory, and external audits. Ensure compliance with applicable tax, statutory requirements, accounting standards, and internal financial controls. Work closely with the central Finance team and other operational departments. Identify opportunities to improve financial processes and controls. Qualifications & Experience Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field . 4–5 years of experience in accounting, finance, or audit. Strong experience in cash, bank, POS, and revenue reconciliation. Experience in financial reporting and accounting operations. Experience with payroll, incentives, allowances, and related calculations. Good knowledge of tax, statutory compliance, and financial controls . Experience supporting internal and external audits. Strong knowledge of Microsoft Excel and accounting/ERP systems. Experience with budgeting, cost control, and financial analysis. Experience within BPO, Visa Services, Travel, Tourism, Hospitality, Banking, or service-centre operations is an advantage. CPA, ACCA, CMA, or equivalent professional qualification is preferred. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and culturally diverse environment. Key Skills Accounting | Financial Reporting | Cash Reconciliation | Revenue Reconciliation | Payroll | Tax & Statutory Compliance | Audit & Financial Controls | MS Excel | ERP/Accounting Systems | Budget & Cost Control | Financial Analysis

title: Anesthetist
description: Company Description Wollo University CMHS Anesthesia Department is part of the College of Medicine and Health Sciences, dedicated to delivering safe, evidence-based perioperative and critical care services. The department supports surgical and medical teams through comprehensive anesthesia care for a wide range of procedures. It focuses on training future anesthesia professionals, promoting clinical excellence, and engaging in academic activities. Team members work in a collaborative environment that values ethical practice, continuous learning, and patient-centered care. Role Description The Anesthetist will provide anesthesia care for patients undergoing surgical and diagnostic procedures in an on-site, hospital-based setting in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. Day-to-day responsibilities include preoperative assessment, planning appropriate anesthesia techniques, administering general and regional anesthesia, and monitoring patients during and after procedures. The role involves participating in critical care management, supporting postoperative pain control, and responding to anesthesia-related emergencies. The Anesthetist will collaborate closely with surgeons, physicians, nurses, and other healthcare professionals to ensure safe, high-quality patient outcomes and may contribute to teaching and mentoring within the department. This is a full-time, on-site position. Qualifications Strong foundation in anesthesiology and medicine, with the ability to apply clinical knowledge to diverse patient populations. Competence in general anesthesia and related techniques for a variety of surgical and procedural settings. Experience or training in critical care medicine, including perioperative monitoring and management of unstable patients. Ability to work effectively within surgical teams and support safe surgical care across multiple specialties. Recognized medical degree and formal training in anesthesia; relevant certification or licensure as required by national regulations. Demonstrated commitment to patient safety, ethical clinical practice, and adherence to institutional and national clinical guidelines. Effective communication, teamwork, and documentation skills, with the ability to work in a high-demand clinical environment. Interest in teaching, continued professional development, and participation in departmental academic or quality improvement activities.

title: Communications Manager

The role will provide strategic communication advice to the CEO and senior leadership, strengthen corporate reputation and visibility, and manage communication risks and issues. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement the corporate communications and PR strategy and annual plan. Lead media relations, press engagement, corporate announcements and public relations activities. Manage relationships with government institutions, regulators, industry associations and other strategic stakeholders. Lead corporate reputation, issues and crisis communication. Develop executive communications, speeches, key messages, press releases and other corporate content. Coordinate corporate events, stakeholder engagements and visibility initiatives. Work with Marketing and Digital teams to align corporate and digital communications. Monitor media coverage, public perception and emerging reputational risks. Manage PR agencies, external communication partners and the corporate communications budget. Prepare regular corporate communications reports and dashboards for management. Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in corporate communications, public relations, media relations or a related field. Experience in FMCG, beverage, manufacturing, consumer goods or a multinational corporate environment is an advantage. Proven experience working with senior executives, media, government institutions and external stakeholders. Key Competencies Strategic communication and corporate PR Media and stakeholder relationship management Corporate reputation and crisis communication Excellent written and verbal communication Executive communication and presentation Strong networking and relationship-building Sound judgment, discretion and confidentiality Strong project management and problem-solving skills People First Consult Connecting talent with opportunity

title: Brand Manager
description: People First Consult is looking for a Brand Manager on behalf of one of its clients, a company in the beer and beverage sector . Position: Brand Manager Location: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia Reports to: Marketing Manager Role Summary The Brand Manager will be responsible for developing and executing the brand strategy and marketing initiatives for a leading beer brand. The role will drive brand growth through consumer insights, integrated marketing campaigns, brand activation and innovation, while ensuring consistent brand positioning and identity across all consumer touchpoints. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute the brand strategy in line with business objectives and market opportunities. Own brand positioning, identity, architecture and long-term growth plans. Monitor brand health, market trends, consumer behavior and competitor activities to identify growth opportunities. Translate consumer and market insights into impactful marketing initiatives and campaigns. Lead the planning, execution and evaluation of integrated BTL, digital, traditional and experiential marketing activities. Work closely with creative agencies, Sales, Trade Marketing and other internal teams to ensure effective market execution. Identify opportunities for product innovation, brand extensions and portfolio development. Manage relationships with agencies, suppliers and strategic external partners. Monitor brand performance against KPIs and provide recommendations to improve effectiveness. Manage the brand budget and ensure efficient allocation of marketing resources. Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Management or a related field. Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in brand management, marketing or a related role. Proven experience developing and executing successful brand strategies and marketing campaigns. Strong understanding of consumer behavior, market research and marketing analytics. Experience working with creative agencies and cross-functional teams. Experience in FMCG, beverage, consumer goods or a multinational environment is an advantage. Key Competencies Strategic thinking and strong business acumen Strong brand management and marketing expertise Consumer and market insight orientation Creative and innovative mindset Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Excellent communication and presentation skills Strong stakeholder and agency management Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment People First Consult Connecting talent with opportunity

title: Maintenance Planner/Scheduler
description: Join Vylor—Powering the Future of Agriculture At Vylor, we’re advancing agriculture through breakthrough science—combining elite germplasm, cutting-edge biotech, and next-generation expertise in gene editing and molecular breeding. Our portfolio includes trusted industry brands like Pioneer®, Brevant®, and Hoegemeyer®, delivering performance farmers rely on. Join us to help scale innovation globally and shape what’s next in crop science. We’re hiring for a Maintenance Planner/Scheduler to join our team in Addis Adaba, Ethiopia. Key Responsibilities Develop detailed maintenance schedules for preventive, predictive, corrective, and shutdown maintenance activities. Create and manage work orders within the CMMS/SAP maintenance system. Coordinate maintenance plans with Operations to ensure equipment availability and minimize production disruptions. Prioritize maintenance activities based on safety, compliance, operational impact, and asset criticality. Plan and schedule manpower, contractors, tools, and materials required for maintenance work. Monitor maintenance backlog and drive timely execution of planned work. Coordinate plant shutdowns, turnarounds, and major maintenance activities. Ensure spare parts, materials, and resources are available before scheduled work begins. Track maintenance KPIs including schedule compliance, backlog, equipment downtime, and work order completion rates. Analyze maintenance performance data and recommend continuous improvement initiatives. Maintain accurate maintenance records, equipment history, and asset documentation. Support root cause analysis and reliability improvement initiatives. Ensure all maintenance activities comply with company safety, environmental, and quality standards. Together with site team, perform conduct all necessary plant maintenance. Coordinate (as a shift lead) and carry out seed conditioning at Menagesha as well as on any other 3rd party plants. Make seed quality checks during conditioning. Follow-up the proper bagging. Make sure appropriate use of PPEs during conditioning. Make sure all safety procedures followed during conditioning. Location: Addis Adaba, Ethiopia Qualifications And Required Skills Diploma or Degree in Engineering, Maintenance, or a related field. Experience in maintenance planning, scheduling, and plant maintenance within a manufacturing or agricultural environment. Proficiency in SAP/CMMS and Microsoft Office. Strong knowledge of preventive and corrective maintenance, asset reliability, and spare parts management. Excellent planning, analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder coordination skills. Commitment to safety, quality, and continuous improvement. Experience in seed processing or agricultural operations is an advantage. Willingness and flexibility to work shifts (including weekends / public holidays to support operational requirements). Reliable transportation. Corteva announced to separate our current advanced seed and genetics business to establish a standalone company, operating as Vylor, Inc. The process of the planned separation is anticipated to be completed the fourth quarter of 2026, subject to legal requirements and board approval. Should you accept this position, it is anticipated that, following conclusion of the separation, you would be an employee of Vylor, Inc. and your employment would be governed by Vylor, Inc. employment processes, programs, policies, and benefit plans. In that case, details of any planned changes would be provided to you by Vylor, Inc. at an appropriate time and subject to any necessary consultation processes. Vylor is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to embracing our differences to enrich lives, advance innovation, and boost company performance. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, military or veteran status, pregnancy related conditions (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), disability or any other protected status in accordance with federal, state, or local laws.
